description: Submit module_id with data_tsv, request_id and optional params. Keep all input data in data_tsv and module settings in params. Return submission status, request_id and poll_after_seconds when queued. Poll get_result with the original ID. Public access uses source IP limits; annual clients share account quotas. Consult get_faq mcp-ip-limits for current concurrency and rolling limits. / 提交绘图，数据放 data_tsv，模块选项放 params；返回受理状态和请求编号，排队时返回轮询间隔。使用原编号查询结果。

data_tsv.description: For a single text input, send text directly or use an inputs key-to-text object. For multiple inputs, put all required inputs in one object using exact inputs keys. Use finalized upload mappings for uploaded inputs. For input_mode=none send an empty string or {}. The inline payload limit is 1 MiB. / 单个文本输入可直接传文本或按 inputs 键名组成对象；多输入在同一个对象中按准确键名提供所有必填项，上传输入使用最终返回的映射。input_mode=none 传空字符串或 {}。内联载荷上限 1 MiB。
data_tsv.title: Data Tsv

module_id.description: Exact ID from the modules mapping returned by list_modules. For execution or upload, choose an available module. / 使用 list_modules 返回的 modules 对象中的准确键名；执行或上传须选可用模块。
module_id.title: Module Id

params.description: Module parameter name-to-value object at the top-level params key. Supply required_parameters_without_defaults and requested overrides using names and types from get_module_schema. If none apply, omit params or use {}. / 模块参数统一放在顶层 params 对象里，按 get_module_schema 的名称和类型提供无默认值的必填项及需覆盖的选项。无参数可省略或传 {}。
params.title: Params

request_id.description: Use a new UUID for each new task. For polling or checking a timeout, reuse the original ID. / 每个新任务用新 UUID；轮询或超时查询沿用原编号。
request_id.title: Request Id
